topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Rain was coming down in sheets, same way the news hit me. Thought a surprise party was in the works, you know, the kind where you get good and toasted and laugh till it hurts. Turns out, it was a damp squib, flatlined before it got off the ground. Word had it the place, a cozy joint downtown, was booked for a funeral instead. Figures, right? Doesn’t surprise me much anymore. The city’s a funny place; you expect one thing, the universe laughs and gives you the opposite. Just another twist in the plot, another turn of the wheel. But hey, maybe next time the stars’ll align right, and the champagne will flow. For now, I’ll take my(loader) glass and toast to the unpredictables.
